title.en: M phase: the stages of mitosis

hook.en: When a cell divides by mitosis, both daughters get exactly the same set of chromosomes. Watch how the cell pulls this off without a single mistake.
hook.kn: ಜೀವಕೋಶವು ಸಮಸೂತ್ರ ವಿಭಜನೆಯಾದಾಗ ಎರಡೂ ಮರಿಜೀವಕೋಶಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಂದೇ ರೀತಿಯ ವರ್ಣತಂತುಗಳು ದೊರೆಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಇದು ಹೇಗೆ ತಪ್ಪಿಲ್ಲದೆ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ನೋಡೋಣ.

objectives.en: Describe prophase, metaphase, anaphase and telophase.
Explain the role of kinetochores and spindle fibres.
Identify the best stage to study chromosome morphology.

narration.en: When a cell divides by mitosis, both daughters get exactly the same set of chromosomes. Watch how the cell pulls this off without a single mistake.
narration.kn: ಜೀವಕೋಶವು ಸಮಸೂತ್ರ ವಿಭಜನೆಯಾದಾಗ ಎರಡೂ ಮರಿಜೀವಕೋಶಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಂದೇ ರೀತಿಯ ವರ್ಣತಂತುಗಳು ದೊರೆಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಇದು ಹೇಗೆ ತಪ್ಪಿಲ್ಲದೆ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ನೋಡೋಣ.

body.en: Mitosis is an equational division: the parent and daughter cells have the same chromosome number. In prophase, chromosomal material condenses into compact mitotic chromosomes, each made of two chromatids joined at the centromere; the centrosome, which had duplicated in interphase, moves towards opposite poles and its asters and spindle fibres form the mitotic apparatus. By the end of prophase the Golgi complexes, endoplasmic reticulum, nucleolus and nuclear envelope are no longer seen. Metaphase begins once the nuclear envelope has completely disintegrated: chromosomes spread through the cytoplasm, condensation is complete and morphology is easiest to study. Spindle fibres attach to the kinetochores, small disc-shaped structures at the centromere, and the chromosomes line up at the equator, the metaphase plate.

points.en: Prophase: condensation; nuclear envelope, nucleolus, Golgi and ER disappear.
Metaphase: chromosomes on the metaphase plate; best stage for counting and studying morphology.
Kinetochores: sites of spindle fibre attachment.

By the end of prophase the Golgi complexes, endoplasmic reticulum, nucleolus and nuclear envelope are no longer seen. narration.kn: ಪೂರ್ವಾವಸ್ಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವರ್ಣತಂತುಗಳು ಸಾಂದ್ರವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ, ಕೋಶಕೇಂದ್ರ ಕವಚ ಮತ್ತು ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯೋಲಸ್ ಕಣ್ಮರೆಯಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಮಧ್ಯಾವಸ್ಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವರ್ಣತಂತುಗಳು ಮಧ್ಯಫಲಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಲಾಗಿ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತವೆ; ವರ್ಣತಂತುಗಳ ಆಕಾರ ಅಧ್ಯಯನಕ್ಕೆ ಇದು ಉತ್ತಮ ಹಂತ.

body.en: In anaphase each centromere splits, the two chromatids separate, and the daughter chromosomes move to opposite poles with the centromere leading and the arms trailing. In telophase the chromosomes cluster at the poles and lose their identity as discrete elements; the nuclear envelope forms around each cluster, giving two daughter nuclei, and the nucleolus, Golgi complex and ER reform.

points.en: Anaphase: centromeres split; chromatids move to opposite poles.
Telophase: nuclear envelope, nucleolus, Golgi and ER reappear.

narration.kn: ಉತ್ತರಾವಸ್ಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸೆಂಟ್ರೋಮಿಯರ್ ವಿಭಜನೆಯಾಗಿ ಕ್ರೊಮ್ಯಾಟಿಡ್‌ಗಳು ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಧ್ರುವಗಳಿಗೆ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಅಂತ್ಯಾವಸ್ಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೋಶಕೇಂದ್ರ ಕವಚ ಮತ್ತು ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯೋಲಸ್ ಮತ್ತೆ ರೂಪುಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ.

aim.en: Study the stages of mitosis in onion root tip cells and find the mitotic index.

narration.en: Virtual lab. Aim: Study the stages of mitosis in onion root tip cells and find the mitotic index.

problem.en: An onion root tip squash shows 400 cells: 340 in interphase, 30 in prophase, 12 in metaphase, 8 in anaphase and 10 in telophase. Find the mitotic index.

steps.en: Mitotic index = dividing cells ÷ total cells × 100.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. An onion root tip squash shows 400 cells: 340 in interphase, 30 in prophase, 12 in metaphase, 8 in anaphase and 10 in telophase. Find the mitotic index.

body.en: Interphase, then Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, Telophase. Prophase Packs (condenses), Metaphase lines up in the Middle, Anaphase pulls Apart, Telophase builds Two nuclei.

narration.en: The order of mitosis: IPMAT. Interphase, then Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, Telophase. Prophase Packs (condenses), Metaphase lines up in the Middle, Anaphase pulls Apart, Telophase builds Two nuclei.

mnemonic.en: "I Pray More At Temple" = Interphase, Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, Telophase

points.en: Mitosis is equational: daughters keep the parental chromosome number.
points.kn: ಸಮಸೂತ್ರ ವಿಭಜನೆ ಸಮವಿಭಜನೆ: ವರ್ಣತಂತು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಬದಲಾಗದು.

points.en: Prophase: condensation; envelope and nucleolus vanish.
Metaphase: chromosomes on the metaphase plate, attached at kinetochores.
Anaphase: centromeres split; telophase: nuclei reform.
points.kn: ಉತ್ತರಾವಸ್ಥೆ: ಸೆಂಟ್ರೋಮಿಯರ್ ವಿಭಜನೆ; ಅಂತ್ಯಾವಸ್ಥೆ: ಕೋಶಕೇಂದ್ರಗಳ ಪುನರ್ರಚನೆ.

homework.en: Draw labelled diagrams of the four stages of mitosis in an animal cell.

narration.en: Recap. Mitosis is equational: daughters keep the parental chromosome number. Prophase: condensation; envelope and nucleolus vanish. Metaphase: chromosomes on the metaphase plate, attached at kinetochores. Anaphase: centromeres split; telophase: nuclei reform.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸಮಸೂತ್ರ ವಿಭಜನೆ ಸಮವಿಭಜನೆ: ವರ್ಣತಂತು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಬದಲಾಗದು. ಪೂರ್ವಾವಸ್ಥೆ: ಸಾಂದ್ರೀಕರಣ; ಕೋಶಕೇಂದ್ರ ಕವಚ ಕಣ್ಮರೆ. ಮಧ್ಯಾವಸ್ಥೆ: ಮಧ್ಯಫಲಕದಲ್ಲಿ ವರ್ಣತಂತುಗಳು. ಉತ್ತರಾವಸ್ಥೆ: ಸೆಂಟ್ರೋಮಿಯರ್ ವಿಭಜನೆ; ಅಂತ್ಯಾವಸ್ಥೆ: ಕೋಶಕೇಂದ್ರಗಳ ಪುನರ್ರಚನೆ.
